item.content:encoded:
Yeah, I'm also of the opinion that there needs to be more here. It needs to be infinitely more grotesque and spine-chilling. Grease and sweat is such a squicky, uncomfortable subject for so many people (including myself) that I'd be disappointed if this became the only piece on the site that properly tapped into it.

I'm novoting on the basis that there's an awful lot of potential here, I just really hope you come back and revise and create something that really makes me squirm in my seat.

item.content:encoded: I feel like it's not visceral enough. Like, the image is there but you're leaving a lot of the imagery up to the reader. Fuck that. This is a body horror creepypasta. Turn that shit up to 110 and make us hate you for writing it and squicking us out so bad. Be gross. Give details. Make this protagonist whose eyes we're supposed to be seeing this through more relatable. I think that's what Peeled and Picking have that this doesn't. I can see myself in those protagonists' respective shoes. Not this person, so much.

I can't shake the memory of Frank Reynolds from IASIP lying naked on the floor, covered in hand sanitizer, screaming "I JUST WANTED TO BE PURE"

No vote from me. It's a bit too.. cliche? for me. There's plenty of horror stories about people killing themselves due to wanting to get clean.

I didn't vote down because I thought this was well executed and well written, but the idea itself just felt overused to me. From this tale, it seems like you're a really good writer, and I think if you did a more original idea it'd do much better.
